posts.text: GOOD NEWS: 59 countries have agreed to develop national roadmaps for phasing out fossil fuels after attending the first ever conference aimed at phasing out fossil fuels in Santa Marta, Colombia.
Most of the climate articles from the BBC that I need to read for work are now behind a paywall for Americans!
I wish I knew who started the rumor. It’s taken off like wildfire on TikTok, and anyone who tries to refute it is immediately attacked.

I can only offer anecdotal evidence, but the one time I tried to refute the misinformation that data centers are the largest users of water globally, thousands of users unfollowed me and strangers sent me threats of violence because they thought I was pro-AI.

The UAE quitting OPEC was truly not on my 2026 bucket list considering dozens of UAE-backed bot accounts threatened to doxx me when I kept calling out the hypocrisy of the UAE hosting COP back in 2023..
People say that "individual actions" like changing your lightbulbs don't matter, but that right there is a lot of destroyed demand!

So if you’ve been freaking out about a potential AMOC collapse, read this because it’s not as likely as the media/social media is making it out to be.
